subject: Notice: interleaved token emit slowdown impacting streaming sessions - recommended mitigations
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintra.com>, ops@fintra.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: interleaved token emit slowdown impacting streaming sessions - recommended mitigations

Hi Samir / Fintra ops team,

We detected an intermittent increase in token-emission latency on our streaming/chat endpoints starting ~08:45 PDT this morning and lasting in elevated form through the morning peak. The symptom set we saw: prolonged per-token gaps (jittered pulses of 150-600ms) for ~12% of streaming sessions, and a higher tail latency for sessions with >1024 context length.

What we have done so far (short-term):
- Routed a subset of traffic for affected shards to warmed GPU pools with a kernel fallback (approx. 30% of your traffic routed at 09:05 PDT).
- Enabled conservative batching thresholds for model variants serving your tenant to reduce head-of-line waits.
- Applied a quick KV-cache refresh to reduce cache contention on long-context requests.

Customer-facing mitigations you can apply immediately:
1) Client-side: implement a small exponential backoff for streaming reconnects (100ms -> 200ms -> 400ms) before failing the session; this avoids tight poll retries that amplify the backpressure.
2) Polling fallback: if your UI can tolerate a slight UX change, switch long-running sessions (>12s without tokens) to a short-polling strategy for the remainder of the exchange.
3) API config: temporarily reduce max_tokens_per_chunk to 256 for streaming calls that frequently hit >1k context. This reduces per-token scheduling overhead.

Attachments included: a telemetry snapshot (telemetry-snapshot-20270308.zip) with token timing histograms and our mitigation playbook (customer-mitigation-playbook.pdf).

Immediate ask: can your team enable client-side backoff and the temporary chunk-size change for the next 24 hours so we can validate reduced impact? If you prefer, we can open a short maintenance window and take the bulk of your traffic onto warmed pools for up to 2 hours.

We're continuing to run targeted validation against your traffic; I'll send a follow-up with timeline and a proposed post-incident review.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintra.com>

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: interleaved token emit slowdown impacting streaming sessions - recommended mitigations

Thanks for the heads up, Soojin — appreciate the quick action. A few clarifying Qs: 
- How long do you expect the conservative batching to remain in place?
- Can you confirm whether the routing to warmed pools incurs any change to our egress region or billing?
- We saw 10-12% of our sessions degrade (mainly agent-assist flows during peak). We'll enable the client-side backoff in a feature flag today, but need a short checklist for the engineering team to validate.

Also, we will want to discuss SLA credits if this reaches the 99.5% availability guarantees for streaming. Please put the relevant telemetry in the doc so our procurement and SRE can review.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Reliability, Fintra

Hi Samir — quick update and next steps after today's validation window.

What we validated (summary):
- After routing ~40% of your traffic to warmed pools and applying conservative batching at 11:05 PDT, your affected session percentage dropped from ~12% -> ~2.5% within 20 minutes. p95 token gap reduced by ~220ms.
- No region/egress changes were required during the migration. There is no change to your billing profile for the temporary shift — we'll confirm in the postmortem but expect no charge delta for this 2-hour mitigation.

Confirmed next steps: 
- We will send a customer-facing postmortem draft by 2027-03-11 17:00 PDT. Laura will lead the executive summary and credit proposal; Ben will finalize the technical appendix.
- Action for your team: enable the client-side backoff flag and the chunk-size config for 24 hours; monitor token_emit_gap.p99 and report any regressions to ops@fintra.com and me.
- We'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up on 2027-03-12 10:00 PDT to walk through the postmortem and credit ask.

Thanks again for quick collaboration. I’ve attached the telemetry snapshot and the playbook we used; the postmortem will include the step-by-step timeline and the kernel-selection fix path.

If you want an earlier sync, happy to stand up a call.

Best,
Soojin
